name: ugv_approach_man_left3
prompt: STATIC CAMERA SETUP: The camera is mounted on a fixed tripod, capturing the entire scene. CAMERA VELOCITY: 0 (No zoom, no dolly). ACTION: The existing black wheeled robot in the foreground first executes a sharp pivot turn to align with the man on the left (wearing the black shirt). It then executes a straight-line drive across the carpet toward him. The robot maintains a steady, smooth pace. TERMINATION: The robot comes to a complete, smooth stop exactly 1 meter in front of the man on the left. PHYSICS: The robot maintains constant wheel contact with the floor. The two men remain completely stationary throughout the video.
negative_prompt: robot flies, robot changes design, morphing objects, unstable camera, camera movement, zoom in, dolly, shaky footage, motion blur on background.
